answer: To suppress Sybil swarms, nodes emit a verifiable identity signal by depositing collateral into a cryptographic stake-burning harbor. When registering identities, protocol friction imposes quadratic penalty burns where required sacrifice scales as O(n^2) rather than linearly. Any actor trying to harbor multiple identities in this isolated liquidity lagoon faces superlinear cost scaling, making coordinated puppet attacks mathematically and economically unviable.
